_comment: Baselines for scripts/screenshot.sh. Numbers here are measurements from a real run, not hand-picked targets. Regenerate with `scripts/screenshot.sh --update` after a deliberate visual change, then read the printed diff before committing — a diff that isn't explained by your change means something regressed.

reference_capture.note: 393x852 logical window (WIDTH/HEIGHT in src/main.rs) captured on a 1.25x-scale display. Every crop below is defined in these physical pixels and scaled proportionally at run time to whatever size the window is actually captured at, so a different display scale factor doesn't require re-authoring the geometry.

checks.name: thumb_painted
checks.description: The library's first row 38x38 attachment thumb is actually painted, not just laid out. Caught the display:contents paint regression (README: 'The paint regression') where boxes were sized correctly but never drawn.
checks.note: Reference: ~0.913 painted (grey fill), ~0.970 unpainted (bare paper) — a delta far outside tolerance.
